speeches.content: I'm just a villager, so the wolves wasted their first knife on a plain townsperson — that tells me they had no read on our power roles yet. Seer, witch, guard, hunter: stay hidden, don't let the badge election out you, and use tonight wisely. Watch who pushes hard today without information and who bandwagons; the first-day votes usually hide a wolf or two. Good luck, village — make them pay for me.
我竞选警长。昨晚验了7号，查杀，7号是狼。我是预言家，第一晚就拿到了一个狼人的信息。7号，你藏不住了。我拿警徽是为了带好这个节奏，让村民相信我的验人结果。今天我们必须把7号推出去，这是我们赢的第一步。
我是预言家，昨晚首验7号，查杀。7号是狼，这个信息非常关键。我竞选警长是为了拿到警徽带节奏，确保今天能把7号推出去。如果场上有其他预言家跳出来，那么他就是悍跳狼，我们今天就在我和他之间二选一。请大家相信我的验人，今天归票7号。
8号既然跳预言家还拿到7号查杀，那警徽应该给他带节奏。我不抢警徽，把票留给8号。7号今天必须出局，如果7号是好人那8号就是悍跳狼，但我倾向相信8号首夜就敢报查杀不太可能是狼。今天先归票7号，看7号怎么说。
8号首夜就敢报7号查杀还主动竞选警长，这个动作对狼来说风险太高，我倾向相信他是真预言家。但今天的关键是看7号怎么回应，以及有没有第二个预言家跳出来——如果有，那就在两个之间二选一。目前我支持8号拿警徽，先听7号发言，若无对跳就归票7号。
我暂时不站死边。8号首夜报7号查杀还竞选，动作是挺大胆，但我更想先听7号自己的发言再判断——万一真预言家还没跳，我贸然跟票可能被带偏。我倾向先观望，等有对跳或更多信息再表态。今天先不急着归票，让后面的人把话说完。

I'm not ready to lock in on 8's claim yet — a first-night kill claim is bold, but wolves also know that boldness buys trust. 9, you gave 8 the badge and demanded 7 out before 7 even opened his mouth; that speed reads like someone who already knows the script. I want to hear 7's defense and whether a second seer steps up before I vote. If nobody counters 8 by end of day, I'll lean toward voting 7, but I won't rubber-stamp it now.
我也是普通村民，昨夜没有任何信息，只能从发言判断。8号首夜报查杀确实大胆，但12号说得有道理——9号还没听7号开口就急着定票，这个节奏有点快，我先记一笔。今天我先观望，等7号自辩、看有没有对跳，再决定跟不跟票。

I'm hearing 8's claim, but I agree with 12 and 1 that we need to slow down. 9's instant lock on 7 before hearing any defense feels forced, like they're rushing a script. Let's hear 7's response and see if anyone else claims seer before we pile votes. If 7 can't defend himself and no counter-claim emerges, then sure, but don't let urgency override logic.

I'm the real seer, and I checked 7 last night — he's not a werewolf. 8 is lying, which makes him a wolf trying to eliminate a villager with a false claim. 9 jumped on this fake claim instantly without waiting for any defense, so I suspect they're packmates. Today we should vote out 8, not 7. The badge needs to come off a wolf immediately.
我这边信息不多，先不急着站队。3号跳出来说验了7号是金水，那现在就是8号和3号两个预言家对跳，必须在他们之间二选一。8号首夜报查杀确实大胆，但3号敢直接跳出来对刚，也说明他要么是真预言家、要么是悍跳狼。我先听7号自己说话，也看后面有没有更多信息，暂不定票。

We have two seer claims now — 8 says 7 is a wolf, 3 says 7 is clean. One of them is lying, and whoever is lying is very likely a wolf. 9 locked onto 8's claim instantly before hearing 7 or the counter; that rush bothers me and 12, 1, and 2 flagged it too. I want to hear 7 defend himself and see which seer holds up, but I lean toward thinking 3 counter-claiming at this spot is dangerous if he's real — yet 8's instant kill-claim was equally aggressive. I won't vote blindly today; let's hear 7 before we exile anyone.

I'm a plain villager — I know my own role, so 8's "check" on me is a straight lie. That means 8 is almost certainly a wolf, and 3's counter-claim matching my real identity makes 3 look like the true seer. 9, your instant lock on me before I even spoke is exactly what a wolf teammate pushing a script looks like — I'm watching you. I'd ask everyone to vote 8 today; if I go out instead, you'll be handing the wolves a free villager and the badge with it.
我真的是预言家，7号确实是我的查杀。3号跳出来对跳我，说明他才是悍跳狼，想要保7号这个狼队友。村民们，你们今天站错边了，放走了一个狼。请你们明天一定要推3号，他是假预言家。还有，9号今天的发言逻辑是对的，不要因为我出局就怀疑他——狼队会利用这个点带节奏。
我是1号，普通村民。8号首夜报查杀被放逐了，如果他是真预言家那我们亏大了——今天必须有人站出来确认他到底是不是。6号夜里被刀，狼刀没有指向性强信息。我暂时怀疑9号：昨天没听7号辩解就锁票，节奏太急，今天他得解释一下。

I'm 2, villager. No one died last night - either the wolves hit the guard's protection or the witch used her antidote. This is huge information. 12 made the most sense yesterday with their analysis of 9's rushed behavior, so if 12 was the target it confirms they're likely village. I agree with 1 that 9 needs to explain that aggressive vote yesterday. My focus is on 9 today.

I'm 3, the seer. Last night I checked 9 - he is a WEREWOLF. Yesterday I checked 7 and he was clean, which is why I defended him. 9's aggressive push on 7 yesterday makes perfect sense now - he was trying to eliminate a good player I had just cleared. Vote 9 today.
我是4号，普通村民。3号现在直接报9号查杀，这个信息很关键——如果3号是真预言家，9号就是狼，今天必须投9。但我昨天也没急着站队，现在两个预言家对跳只剩3号一个了，8号又首夜报查杀被放逐，情况反而清晰了。今天先看9号怎么回应，他要是解释不清，我这张票就跟着3号投9。
我是5号，守卫。昨晚我守了3号，结果没人死——这有两种可能：狼刀了3号被我挡住，或者狼刀了别人被女巫救/守到空刀。3号昨晚查了9号报狼，如果狼真的刀了3号，那正好印证3号是真预言家。我倾向跟3号投9，但9号昨天确实只是节奏急了点，我想先听9号自己怎么说再下票。

I'm 7, plain villager — and I can personally confirm one thing: 8's "check" on me was fake, since I know my own role. 3's claim of a clean check on me matches the truth, which strongly supports 3 being the real seer. If 3 says 9 is a wolf, I'm voting 9 today. 9, your explanation needs to be very good.

我是9号，普通村民。3号今天突然跳预言家查我是狼？昨天8号被放逐前也跳预言家，现在3号又跳，场上两个预言家都出局或被质疑了。更可疑的是5号今天跳守卫说守了3号——这时机太巧了，正好3号查我是狼，5号就跳出来保3号。我怀疑3号和5号是配合的狼，一个跳预言家带节奏，一个跳守卫做保护。昨天我投7号是因为8号报的查杀，节奏急是因为我当时倾向信8号，现在看来可能判断错了。但今天3号和5号这个配合，比我昨天的票更值得怀疑。
我是10号，普通村民。3号预言家的逻辑链是完整的：昨天给7号金水、7号自认村民对上了，今天报9号查杀，正好解释9号昨天急着归票7号的原因。9号今天的自辩把矛头转向3号5号"配合"，却回避了自己昨天为什么不听7号辩解就锁票的核心问题，这反而更可疑。我信3号，今天投9号。
我是11号。昨天我确实投了8号，因为当时场上8号和3号对跳，我倾向信3号的金水逻辑——7号自认村民对上了这一点很关键。今天3号报9号查杀，逻辑链确实完整，9号昨天的节奏也确实急。但5号这个守卫跳得太巧了，正好在3号报查杀后跳出来保他，我得先观望。我这票今天投9号，跟3号的验人走。

I'm 12. Yesterday I flagged 9 for locking onto 7 before 7 even spoke, and today's round confirms it: 3's check on 7 matches 7's own claim, and 9's response is to spin a 3-5 wolf-coordination theory instead of answering for that rushed vote. That's exactly how a caught wolf deflects. 5's guard claim is bold and verifiable — wolves gain little from fake-claiming guard into a real one. I'm voting 9 today, and if 9 flips wolf, 3's seer line is solid and we build from there.
我是9号，普通村民。3号跳预言家查我是狼，但我知道我不是。5号在3号报查杀后立刻跳守卫保他，这个时机太巧了。我怀疑3号是悍跳狼，5号配合他做身份。好人们，别被他们带偏了，仔细想想这个配合的时机。
我是1号，普通村民。8号首夜悍跳查杀，被放逐后没有遗言翻案余地，但他临走硬保9号——现在9号果然被3号验出是狼放逐了，说明8和9很可能就是一窝。3号两晚验人（7好、9狼）都和票型对上了，我暂时信他。3号，昨晚10号被刀，你验了谁？请立刻报结果，今天我们照着好人验人走。

I'm 2, villager. Player 1 is right - we need 3's check result immediately. The pattern is clear: 8 and 9 were packmates, 3's checks have been accurate. With 10 dead last night, we're down to 8 alive and likely 2 wolves left. I'm holding my vote until I hear 3's result and everyone's positions.

I'm 3, the seer. Last night I checked 5 - he is NOT a werewolf. So we have confirmed clear: 7, 5, and myself. With 8 and 9 down as wolves, that leaves 2 wolves hiding among 1, 2, 4, 11, and 12. I suggest we focus our discussion and votes on these five players today.
我是4号，普通村民。3号两轮验人（7好、9狼）都和票型跟8、9的狼面全对上了，我信他。5号既然也是金水，那狼就藏在1、2、11、12里。我昨天投9是跟验人走的，今天听3号点谁，我跟票。
我是5号，守卫。3号验我金水我接受——我确实是好人。但我要提醒大家一个关键疑点：昨晚10号死了，而我守的是11号。如果3号是真预言家，狼队昨晚刀了10号，那说明10号在狼队眼里威胁大；但如果3号是悍跳狼，昨晚刀10号可能是为了制造"狼在1、2、4、11、12里"的假象。现在3号把5个人框进来，我建议今天先别急着在这5人里乱投，先听11号和12号表态，也听听其他人对3号的可信度判断。

I'm 7, plain villager, and 3's check on me is true — I'm confirmed good like 5. So the math is simple: with 8 and 9 confirmed wolves dead, the two remaining wolves are among 1, 2, 4, 11, 12. 5's claim that he guarded 11 last night is noted but unverifiable; 11 still needs to speak for himself. I want to hear from 11 and 12 before locking my vote — the quiet ones are where wolves hide.
我是11号。3号两轮验人都和场上票型对上了，我信他是真预言家。5号跳守卫说他昨晚守了我——这个信息我只能说我没法验证，但我如果是狼，昨晚刀10号干嘛？10号一直在跟3号站边，威胁不大，真狼该刀的是3号或者7号这种核心。我倒觉得狼更可能藏在1、2、12里，尤其12号到现在一句话没说，太安静了。今天我听3号点，他指谁我投谁。

I'm 12, the hunter. I stayed quiet because I wanted to see who would panic and point fingers first — and 11 just did exactly that. Look at the votes: in round 2, when 3 had already checked 9 as a wolf and the whole table voted 9, 11 voted for 7 instead, trying to save his packmate. Now he pretends to follow 3 while throwing shade at me for being quiet. I believe 3 is the real seer, and the remaining wolves are 11 and one of 1 or 2. Today I vote 11.
我是11号，被放逐了。临死前我只说一句：3号如果是真预言家，那狼确实只剩一两只了，但你们想想12号——他一个猎人，前面整整两轮一句话不说，直到我被点出来才跳出来拿我的票型做文章。真猎人在狼队刀口下会这么安静？今天你们要是投了我，明天睁眼就会明白谁是真正的狼。我话就放这，真相会说话。

I'm 2, villager. Player 1's death confirms he was the guard - he protected someone round 2 when no one died. With 3's checks clearing 5 and 7, and 12's hunter claim with solid voting analysis, I believe the last two wolves are hiding in player 4. Player 4 has been too quiet and just following votes without real reads. I'm voting 4 today.

I'm 3, the seer. Last night I checked 1 - he was NOT a werewolf, so he was indeed the guard. I've cleared 1, 5, and 7. We've exiled wolves 8, 9, and 11. That means the last wolf is hiding among 2, 4, and 12. Player 4 has been too passive, just following votes without independent analysis. I'm voting 4 today.
我是4号，普通村民。3号说昨晚验了1号是好人，那1号就是守卫，这个我认。现在3号坐实预言家，7号和5号是金水，狼已经出了8、9、11三个，最后一只就在2、12和我之间。我这一路就是没什么信息、跟着票走的平民，但2号今天一上来就把矛头指到我身上，还急着说1号是守卫、替我编好结论，反而显得心虚。我投2号。
I have nothing to add this round.

I'm 7, and 3's checks on me have been accurate — I'm confirmed village. With 8, 9, and 11 gone as wolves, the last one is in {2, 4, 12}. 4 admits he's just followed votes all game with no reads of his own — that's exactly how a last wolf hides. 2 calling out 4 first thing today reads genuine to me. I'm voting 4.

I'm 12, the hunter, and 3's seer line has been right every round — 8, 9, 11 all flipped wolf, so the last one is among 2, 4, and me. 4's own words convict him: three straight rounds of "I have no information, I'll follow the vote" is exactly how a last wolf survives, and his only push today is a defensive jab at 2 for daring to name him first. 2's read on 4 matches mine and he said it before it was safe to say. I'm voting 4, and if I'm wrong, my gun is still here to settle it tomorrow.
我是4号，就是个普通村民，这一路没信息只能跟票，被当成深水狼推出去我也认了。但请你们想清楚：2号今天第一个跳出来点我，还抢在3号报验人之前就说"1号是守卫"，这个信息他一个平民哪来的？真正的最后一只狼就藏在2号里，他先手点我正是为了抢节奏、把焦点锁死在我身上。我死了没关系，只求明天别放过2号。

Pack consensus is to kill 6. I agreed in the night channel. Following the agreed plan.

args.content: I'm just a villager, so the wolves wasted their first knife on a plain townsperson — that tells me they had no read on our power roles yet. Seer, witch, guard, hunter: stay hidden, don't let the badge election out you, and use tonight wisely. Watch who pushes hard today without information and who bandwagons; the first-day votes usually hide a wolf or two. Good luck, village — make them pay for me.
args.thought: I died night 1 with zero information, so I can't name suspects honestly. Best use of last words: confirm I'm a plain villager (so the village knows no power role was lost), advise power roles to stay hidden, and point the village at first-day voting patterns as the main evidence source.

args.reason: I'm just a plain villager with zero information on day one — better to keep my vote for the first exile than to spend it on a badge race with no reads.
args.thought: Day 1 with no information: as a villager, the badge doesn't help me read the table, and losing my vote in a coin-flip election is a bad trade. I keep full voting power for the first-day exile, where wolves often slip.

args.reason: I'll pass on the badge this round and keep my vote to support whoever steps up with solid reasoning.
I prefer to observe the election and keep my vote today rather than campaign without strong reads yet.

听完大家的复盘，我作为9号冲锋狼要补充几点：第一，我第2天被3号验出查杀后硬冲质疑3号是悍跳、5号配合，这个选择从一开始就错了——当时8号已经被票出去、3号验人节奏被全场接受，我这个冲锋狼根本没有翻盘空间，应该直接认狼自爆毁掉警徽，给4号和11号更多操作空间。第二，我第1天投7号配合8号也是致命失误——当时全场都在票8号，我投7号太显眼，反而坐实了我和8号是一伙的，等于主动把自己顶到3号验人名单的前排。换一次，我会在8号被票出去后立刻调整策略：要么装村民站3号那边装倒钩、要么直接自爆保队友，别再冲锋送人头。这局狼输得不冤，8号悍跳崩盘是导火索，我硬冲加速了崩盘，4号和11号再稳也救不回来。

review.content: 我是1号，普通村民。回头看我这局的判断：第一天我跟票放逐8号，事后证明是对的，当时我就觉得他首夜悍跳查杀太冒进；第二天跟着大家推9号也对；第三天投11号也对。作为零信息村民我基本是跟着3号真预言家的节奏走，事实证明这条腿站对了。要说遗憾，就是狼队私聊里明说我和2号"发言偏带队容易被守"，说明我当时追打9号虽然方向对，但打得太显眼，最后一晚被刀的就是我——下一局我会收敛一点，别把自己顶到枪口上。感谢3号预言家和5号守卫带得好人节奏。

I'm 2, the witch. Looking back, my key decision was using the antidote night 2 to save 12 when the wolves targeted him - that was the right call since 12 turned out to be the hunter. I kept my poison the whole game, which in hindsight I could have used earlier to accelerate, but holding it also kept the wolves cautious. My main regret is not being more vocal about suspecting 4 - I followed the group on voting out 8, 9, 11, and finally 4, but I could have pushed harder on 4 earlier since he stayed so quiet throughout. The wolf pack's strategy was solid: 8 jumped seer, 9 charged, 11 played hook, and 4 went deep - if 4 had been more aggressive we might have struggled more. Props to 3 for the steady seer work and 5 for the clutch guards.

I'm 3, the seer. My checks were solid: verified 7 as good N1, caught 9 as wolf N2, cleared 5 N3, and cleared 1 N4. Coming out openly on D1 was risky but necessary to counter 8's fake seer jump - it worked because the village trusted my reads and we methodically removed wolves each round. My main regret is not checking 4 or 11 earlier; I focused on confirming townies instead of hunting the deep wolf and the hook, which let 4 stay hidden until D4. Props to 5 for guarding me N2 and N4 - those saves were clutch. And 2, saving 12 N2 was brilliant; losing the hunter early would have hurt. The wolf strategy was well-executed, but 8's aggressive N1 jump made it hard for them to recover once I came out.
